split.behavior: one representative per exact URL, then URL-disjoint split

permissions.source_labels: existing18553 pure source rows for fixed auxiliary-view prototype means; existing source anchors/geometry/identity only; no backbone or source classifier retraining
permissions.query_labels: terminal raw and preregistered output-policy metrics, error-pair/frontier/layer diagnostic only; no checkpoint or threshold selection
permissions.url_hostname: split grouping and posthoc clustering metrics only
permissions.source_valid_labels: source-only auxiliary temperature calibration/enable gate and terminal metrics; no target-feedback fitting
permissions.query_input: independent per-sample inference; no query feature, BN, normalization, CDF, GMM or prototype fitting

adaptation.sample_distribution: degenerate Gaussian N(embedding,0); diagonal Gaussian W2 squared / dimension
adaptation.soft_assignment: frozen teacher predicted class; mixture prior times exp(-W2/source median nearest W2)
adaptation.routing: strictly positive batch-momentum soft weights; momentum_v5 is authoritative
adaptation.distance: minimum over all classes and components of mean squared standardized Mahalanobis
adaptation.target_update: full102 fixed soft source-neighbor q, with anchored EMA prototype mixing only in proto/joint
adaptation.acceptance_calibration: source validation: minimum bank log-vote gain threshold over frozen classifier; smallest feasible grid value with >=10 changes, correction:damage>=2 and damage<=1% of baseline correct; fallback reject all
adaptation.neighbor_banks: source rows hash parity; two deterministic disjoint banks
adaptation.tent_protocol: 400x64 reference entropy updates; two query policies: standard batch-stat transductive, and sequential reference-population BN calibration without query statistics

momentum_v5.full_target: softmax(frozen logits /2 + log(mean source neighbor votes)); all102 classes, no Top5 truncation; fixed and detached
momentum_v5.weighting: full_static ones; other arms w=.05+.95*exp(-(H(EMA_probability_i)-batch_EMA_mean)^2/(2*batch_EMA_variance)); detached and strictly positive
momentum_v5.weight_normalization: batch mean w*per-sample losses; relation multiplied by batch mean(w); source identity unchanged
momentum_v5.prototype_update: after optimizer, weighted soft assignment centroid of EMA reference features; step=(1-.95)*class_mass/(class_mass+1); absent mass leaves class unchanged
momentum_v5.prototype_target: q=(1-.25)*fixed_full_q+.25*softmax(cosine(EMA feature, anchored dynamic class prototypes)/.1); detached; computed before current-batch memory update
momentum_v5.contrast_target: detached q_i dot q_j, exclude diagonal, row-normalize; differentiable log-softmax normalized embedding similarity to every other batch sample; soft targets, no hard pseudo labels
momentum_v5.query_output: unconditional original classifier with LoRA; no prototype reranking, no frozen bypass
momentum_v5.reset: model, optimizer, reference memories and102 prototype state reset for every seed/slice/arm
momentum_v5.expansion_gate: joint raw mean deltaF1 >=3pp in BOTH slices; positive each seed in each slice; same-score diagnostic Recovery@NAR1 no worse than full_static on BOTH slices; no expansion by cherry-picking another arm
momentum_v5.budget_stop: 30 tasks only, no target-feedback retries or parameter sweep; report all arms regardless outcome

refinement_v6.hypothesis: separate moving teacher prototypes from fixed source student anchors; sharper geometry or source-class-radius preservation may reduce soft-assignment dilution
refinement_v6.radius_rule: a=0.5*source+0.5*EMAproto; use mean(a) as reference center, restore each class radius around that reference center to centered source radius; zero-radius fallback to source centered class direction; corrected set mean need not equal mean(a)
refinement_v6.matched_baseline: v5 momentum_proto reused predictions; same pure models, split, source anchors, batch streams, full102 q, optimizer and final400 budget
refinement_v6.primary_gate: on BOTH slices, mean deltaF1 over v5 proto >=0.20pp; raw NAR increase <=0.20pp; same frozen common-score Recovery@NAR1 no worse; all source-model seeds positive vs frozen
refinement_v6.secondary_gate: same gate separately for sharp_proto and radius_proto; no relabeling as primary
refinement_v6.expansion_gate: primary gate plus mean deltaF1>=3pp on BOTH slices; no automatic expansion within this run
refinement_v6.selection: all arms fixed final400; no checkpoint/seed/threshold selection for deployed predictions; posthoc label-based frontier thresholds diagnostics only
refinement_v6.budget_stop: 36 new tasks only; no feedback-driven additional arms, epochs or retries except documented implementation repairs

v7.fixed_teacher: original pure reference logits, votes and source prototypes for all four arms; BN arms re-encode reference/source tokens but preserve original source teacher embedding identity
v7.writer_rule: fixed source-calibrated reference reliability: I(head=bank1=bank2)*sigmoid((source_valid_H75-H_frozen)/.1)*sigmoid((.05-JS(mean_bank,head_softmax))/.01); only prototype writes affected, loss gradients remain full positive momentum weighting
v7.mass_control: uniform writer factor=sum(w*r)/sum(w) per batch; matches total weighted writer mass in that arm, not class allocation
v7.probe_metric: unpaired source/reference diagonal Gaussian channel-moment W2 standardized by source-channel SD; paired reference before/after linear CKA only; no irreversible-damage inference
v7.score_fit: query-free: unlabeled changed reference rows for local stats/CDF/GMM; changed source-valid rows for source normalization and source-only threshold calibration
v7.calibration_select: highest source recovered count, then lowest damage, then largest threshold; require recovered>damaged; infeasible reject all
v7.gmm: 1D normalized margin gain on changed unlabeled reference; compare BIC k1 vs k2; n_init3, reg1e-3, random_state20261019; tail high-mean component posterior>=.95 and margin_gain>0; BIC not improved or fewer32 rows => no acceptance; posterior is NOT probability of safe correction

criteria.memory_isolation: memory_route beats memory_mass_control mean F1>=.2pp and same-score Rec@NAR1 not worse on BOTH slices; no positive claim from fewer writes alone
criteria.early_stats: stats_only vs frozen separates reference-stat effect; compare stats_lora vs v6 LoRA with same400 optimization steps and teacher; evidence gate both slices mean F1>=.2pp over LoRA and raw NAR increase<=.2pp
criteria.joint: stats_memory_route vs both stats_lora and memory_route: report interaction, cannot infer layer cause from TENT comparison alone
criteria.scoring: source-calibrated margin_ref_rank on BOTH slices target NAR<=1% and recovery>=combined_source1+.5pp; one source-only fixed rule, no target threshold tuning
criteria.stop: two slices only, no additions based on target scores; no external scoring or full-matrix expansion

v8.baseline: v6 sharp_target_only frozen source BN; reuse verified checkpoint/raw/valid
v8.bn_policy: pure source BN affine and statistics completely frozen; only r4 Q/V4096 LoRA trainable
v8.teacher_caveat: Only direct output KL changes; full102 soft q and geometric losses/memories still inherit original teacher/source-neighbor evidence. Not a teacher-free method.
v8.kl_gate: fixed original reference teacher entropy <= source-valid frozen entropy75 AND original head == nearest source prototype; only KL numerator masked; divide by full batch size
v8.balance: lambda_geo=clip(EMA.9(||grad KL||)/(EMA.9(||grad(.1pull+relation)||)+1e-8),1,50), current batch included; detach; identical .1pull/relation relative weights and identity=1; nearzero geomgrad<=1e-10 gives lambda1
v8.source_probe: No new source model training or source reference row selection; same1024 source anchor tokens/embeddings as v6
v8.common_frontier_signal: raw normalized_margin_gain; all changed candidates eligible, same definition for all methods; query-derived thresholds diagnostic only
v8.mechanism_gate: each of TWO slices mean Recovery@NAR1 improves >=.5pp over fixed v6 LoRA, raw MacroF1 does not decrease, raw NAR increase <=.2pp; retain cluster/commonwrong diagnostics regardless
v8.cluster: Reference-only standardized embeddings KMeans102, n_init3,max_iter100,random_state20261019; query assigned fixed nearest centroid; query-label majority purity/ARI/NMI terminal metrics only; source prototype nearest accuracy reported separately; clusters never used in adaptation or output
v8.common_error: Frozen wrong AND frozen head=source nearest prototype=bank1top1=bank2top1. Report same wrong retention, correction, other wrong transfer in that fixed subset; source-target identity assumption unchanged
v8.score_candidate: all frozen and v6 controls plus all18 new adapters; no candidate selection
v8.score_primary: agreement_q95 on fixed v6 control, evaluated without tuning
v8.score_gate: both slices Recovery no less than margin_ref_rank_source1-.5pp AND each source-seed target NAR<=1%; mean NAR also reported; secondary candidates exploratory
v8.score_fit: Reference inputs only for ECDF/quantiles/envelope; sourcevalid labels only for source1 rule. No query-fitted quantities. No GMM or sigmoid(gain).
v8.tail: changed reference>=32; threshold quantile(method=higher) of unsquashed normalized_margin_gain; query changed,gain>0 and gain>=threshold. q95 and q99 fixed in advance; not safety probabilities
v8.agreement: reference compatible=changed, gain>0, adapted head==adapted nearest source prototype, adapted candidate geometric margin>=frozen candidate geometric margin; require>=32compatible. q95 higher of compatible reference gain; same compatibility at inference. Query never fits envelope.
v8.stop: 18new only,2observed slices, no target-feedback additional arms or broader/external matrix; repairs only with documented implementation cause

v9.baseline: v8 geometry_grad_balance and v6 sharp_target_only, verified historical checkpoints, no retraining
v9.bn: source BN affine/statistics frozen, only existing Q/V r4 LoRA4096 update
v9.smooth: same ratio,ramp; ell initial0; ell_target=log(clipped ratio); ell_requested=.9*ell+.1*ell_target; rate-limit delta ell to .02 for steps<=200 else .005; lambda=1+ramp*(exp(ell)-1); geometry=.1pull+relation; source identity=1,KL=1 unchanged
v9.view: raw TAM2x1800 summed over time blocks1/6/24/120 ->302 log1p counts; source feature standardization; source-only PCA32 orthogonal rows then source variance whitening;102 source class centroids; per-sample Euclidean prototype probabilities; NOT a rotated version of primary128D encoder geometry
v9.view_fit: once from18553 immutable source rows, no optimization/backbone updates; common to all three source seeds; source-only temperature calibration uses2160valid labels minNLL over [.03,.1,.3,1,3,10,30]; sourcevalid MacroF1>=.1 AND NLL<log102 enables auxiliary, otherwise record disabled but run all arms unchanged
v9.view_aux: extra .25*mean(w*c*KL(logsoftmax(student/T2),qview)*T^2); c=1-H(qview)/log102, qview fixed and detached. Full original KL/pull/relation/identity/memory remain; no auxiliary at query inference
v9.shuffled_control: deterministic20261019 permutation of(qview,c) perbatch; rescale shuffled confidence by sum(w*c)/sum(w*c_shuffled) to match total weighted auxiliary mass within that arm; does not guarantee identical cross-arm state trajectories
v9.view_caveat: shares raw traffic and no automatic independence claim. Source-only projection/class centers alter auxiliary representation, not source backbone. Query view predictions only terminal evidence diagnostics, never output routing or target fitting

main_comparisons.stability: smooth vs ramp: both slices late(201:400) mean_abs_delta_loglambda reduction>=30%, aggregate clip count not higher, mean F1 drop<=.1pp and same-margin Rec@NAR1 drop<=.1pp
main_comparisons.efficacy: smooth vs v8: both slices mean F1 no decrease,NAR increase<=.2pp, common margin Rec@NAR1 gain>=.2pp
main_comparisons.auxiliary: smooth_view vs shuffled on both slices commonwrong correction>=+.5pp, mean F1 no decrease,NAR increase<=.2pp; additionally smooth_view vs smooth meanF1 no decrease and Rec@NAR1 no decrease

v9.metrics: all raw Accuracy/F1/NAR/Recovery, same unsquashed margin diagnostic frontiers,reference-only KMeans purity/ARI/NMI, fixed commonwrong transfer; auxiliary standalone sourcevalid/query and conditional error-overlap; no new threshold policy
v9.stability_logs: all steps KL/geometry/aux gradient norms/cosine,lambda and update norm; late delta-loglambda, gradient consecutive cosine summaries, clip counts; step1/200/400 loss gradient components
v9.stop: 24new only, two observed slices and three existing source seeds; no stopped-arm reruns, no target-feedback added settings, no external evaluation, no full-matrix expansion
